newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR, NBH BASKET.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY FORINT ENDS FIRMER VS DLR, NBH BASKET.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed afternoon trade firmer against the dollar on Tuesday and closed the gap that separated it from the central bank's resistance level (bid), dealers said.

The forint closed at 179.93/98 to the dollar, compared with 180.03/08 at midday and 179.70/75 at the opening and the gap that separated it from the central bank's bid was reduced to to a minimal two pips from some 10 pips in morning trade.
"The gap opened on dollar orders and some speculation but but by midday the market settled down," said Gabriella Endrodi of Budapest Bank.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
